# verilog-axi (vendored)

Three files from Alex Forencich's verilog-axi, MIT license (`COPYING`):
`axil_interconnect.v` (the shared AXI4-Lite interconnect used as the
single-bus baseline) and the two modules it uses, `arbiter.v` and
`priority_encoder.v`. Unmodified.

Source: https://github.com/alexforencich/verilog-axi, commit
516bd5dadc3365b7f9e225d2af8fe0b8d804fe53.
